structs.name: surf_csys_data
structs.description: --------------------------------------------------------------------*\ Data structure to describe the information needed by an analysis feature that creates a surface sys. The csys is centered at a datum point on a surface, with its X and Y axes aligned with the U and V mesh lines. The Z axis can be inwards or outwards, by user choice, and the origin can be offset from the datum point by an offset value that is stored as a feature dimension. \*--------------------------------------------------------------------
